 Live Updates WWE WWE SmackDown Live Updates, Results and Highlights From November 20
 Erik Beaston Nov 20, 2026, updated just now 
 Welcome to B/R's coverage of the November 20 episode of WWE SmackDown.
 Scheduled for Friday's show are:
 Trick Williams vs. Damian Priest
 War Games Advantage Match: Charlotte Flair vs. Jade Cargill
 Bakusai vs. The War Raiders
 Tap in, scroll through, and relive the action from this week's show, live from the Ford Center in Evansville, Indiana.
 Live Updates
 6 Total Posts
 Newest First ​ Just Now 05:35 PM Flair vs. Cargill, continued
 Cargill controlled throughout the break, wearing Flair down with a headlock. When The Queen fought back, she dropped her with a big kick, then used the ropes to help choke out Flair.
 Back from the break, Flair fought back and delivered a flurry of chops, then added an insulting slap for good measure. A cross-body block followed, as did a fallaway slam, as the future Hall of Famer built momentum.
 Cargill answered with the Eye of the Storm, but expressed frustration as Flair kicked out at two.
 The heel tried for the pump kick, but Flair caught her with a spear, then scaled the ropes and delivered a moonsault. The Queen covered, but The Storm kicked out as frustration mounted on Flair's side.
 A messy sequence ended with Cargill rocking Flair with the pump kick. She tried for Jaded. Flair countered it and applied the Figure Four. The heel fought her way to the ropes and forced the break.
 Cagill exposed the middle turnbuckle, only to fall victim to a German suplex. Natural Selection followed, but Flair still could not earn the victory.
 More back and forth ensued until the heel sent her opponent face-first into the exposed turnbuckle. Three seconds later and Cargill's team secured the advantage for War Games.
 WINNER: JADE CARGILL 
 Backstage, Candice LeRae confronted Kevin Owens, who told her to tell her husband (Johnny Gargano) to stay out of his way. "And tell him to get a better haircut because...it's just all over the place."
 16 mins ago 05:24 PM War Games Advantage Match: Charlotte Flair vs. Jade Cargill
 The advantage in the Women's War Games Match next Saturday night in Houston was at stake as Charlotte Flair squared off with Jade Cargill, rekindling their rivalry amid higher stakes.
 Neither Flair nor Cargill's partners were allowed at ringside. Ignoring the rules would result in an automatic forfeiture of the advantage.
 Flair downed Cargill early and scaled the ropes for a moonsault, but the former WWE Women's Champion pulled her off the ropes and to the mat below. She covered her for a two-count as the show headed to break.
 Commercial break. 
 21 mins ago 05:19 PM ICYMI: The Rock Returns at Survivor Series
 As revealed Wednesday on the Pat McAfee Show , The Rock will appear at Survivor Series as WWE celebrates 30 years of the Great One. 
 28 mins ago 05:12 PM Gunther Interrupts Kevin Owens and the Main Event Is Set
 The Ring General made his way to the ring and wasted no time, mincing no words with Owens.
 "You were on the shelf for 17 months and, maybe, you should have stayed there."
 Gunther claimed he would not let Owens jump in front of him and take his opportunities. "I am going to give you an option I didn't give your buddy, Finn Balor: get out of my ring and stay out of my way!"
 Owens feigned doing as he was told, even exciting the ring as Gunther continued addressing the fans. 
 The Ring General blamed Sami Zayn for ending his Intercontinental Championship reign at WrestleMania, costing him the WWE Championship against Cody Rhodes, and costing him a tag team victory at Madison Square Garden.
 Owens re-emerged with Aldis, revealed that he pitched the GM on a match-up between him and Gunther, and that he is thankful because he gets to "kick your ass here tonight!"
 35 mins ago 05:05 PM Kevin Owens Kicks Off SmackDown
 The prospective No. 1 contender made his way to the ring, one week after dropping Johnny Gargano with a stunner and staking his claim for a shot at Sami Zayn's Undisputed WWE Championship.
 Chants of "KO" filled the arena as the Prizefighter prepared to address the WWE Universe.
 "I need a match against Sami Zayn for the WWE title, and there's only one man who can make that happen. So Nick...Nick Aldis..."
 Before Owens could call out the SmackDown general manager, a familiar entrance theme interrupted KO. 
 38 mins ago 05:02 PM Setting the Stage
 Charlotte Flair, Tatum Paxley, and Alexa Bliss arrived at the arena ahead of The Queen's match with Jade Cargill, who was also shown arriving with the Women's Tag Team Champions B-Fab and Michin.
 Damian Priest and Trick Williams were also shown arriving ahead of their non-title match later this evening.
